import matplotlib
import numpy as np
# Constants
FUNCTIONS = [np.sin, np.cos, np.tan]
import matplotlib.axes


def task_func(ax, func_index):
    if not isinstance(ax, matplotlib.axes.Axes):
        raise ValueError("The input ax must be a matplotlib Axes instance.")

    func = FUNCTIONS[func_index]

    theta = np.linspace(0.0, 2.0 * np.pi, 2000)
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        r = func(theta)

    r = np.asarray(r, dtype=float)
    r[~np.isfinite(r)] = np.nan
    r = np.clip(r, -10.0, 10.0)

    ax.plot(theta, r)
    ax.set_rlabel_position(func_index * 45)
    ax.grid(True)

    return ax
